diagnosis: The financial contract simulation endpoint accepts compiled WASM bytecode and provides a host function get_account_balance that looks up account_ledgers by accountNumber without checking whether req.user owns that account. An attacker can craft a WASM module that probes balances across other accounts and extracts them through execution branching.
